setting: a grand entrance hall at Christmas, gold-panelled double doors, a staircase wrapped in garland with red ribbons, a huge tree with warm white lights, stacks of wrapped gifts, marble floor, chandeliers and tree lights the only light, snow falling outside the open door

phrase.explain_vi: Đến sai địa chỉ, sai nhà.
phrase.example_en: Sorry, I think I have the wrong house.
phrase.example_vi: Xin lỗi, hình như tôi nhầm nhà rồi.

hook_vi: Mang quà Giáng sinh đến nhầm nhà 🎄

shots.action: Viv pushes through the gold double doors with a tall stack of wrapped gifts in her gloved arms, snow on her fur collar; a kid in a red jumper runs across the hall behind her.
Her gloved hands set the gifts on a side table; a golden retriever puppy's nose pokes over the edge of the table and sniffs the top box.
Jamie comes down the garland-wrapped staircase in a cream cashmere sweater with the puppy under one arm, grinning.

line.vi: Em mang quà à? Cho anh hả?

shots.action: Viv's slow look up the staircase, then down at the gifts, eyes narrowing.

line.vi: Đây là nhà Hartley phải không?

shots.action: Jamie shakes his head slowly while the puppy licks his chin.

line.vi: Nhà bên cạnh. Chung cổng thôi.

shots.action: Viv's red nail taps the gift tag that reads 'To Mrs Hartley'.
Viv lifts her chin, recovers, a smirk starting.

line.en: Then I have the wrong house.
line.vi: Vậy là em nhầm nhà rồi.

shots.action: Jamie holds the puppy out to her; she takes it despite herself, the puppy wriggling against her fur collar.
Viv's face against the puppy's, trying not to smile, the dimple winning.

twist: She came to the wrong house and leaves holding the right dog.
cta_vi: Bạn sẽ ở lại hay đi sang nhà bên? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇

setting: a vintage carousel at night in a Christmas market, white horses with gold poles, warm fairy lights behind, snow falling, black night sky, the carousel bulbs the only light

phrase.explain_vi: 'Lâu lắm rồi (mới gặp / mới làm gì)'. Nói khi gặp lại ai đó sau một thời gian dài.
phrase.example_en: It's been ages! How are you?
phrase.example_vi: Lâu lắm rồi! Dạo này sao?

hook_vi: Gặp lại người cũ ở vòng quay ngựa gỗ 🎠

shots.action: Sienna steps onto the carousel in her shearling-collared coat, snow in her hair, and looks back over her shoulder at someone off frame.
Theo stops dead beside a white horse in his shearling jacket, lips parted, snow on his lashes.
Sienna in profile looks down, smiling, then up at him.
His gloved hand closes on the gold pole just above her bare hand.
Both on white horses side by side as the carousel starts to turn; she laughs holding the pole, her hair lifting, the fairy lights wheeling behind.
Theo bows his head, smiling at the horse's painted mane.
Sienna, chin up, eyes on him, a slow smile.
Theo's smirk straight to camera as the carousel lights streak behind him.

twist: She says she didn't count the days; the exact number says otherwise.
cta_vi: Bạn sẽ nói gì khi gặp lại người cũ? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇

setting: decorated shop fronts on a snowy street at night, a gift-stacked window, a snow-covered tree with gold ornaments, giant gold bells with a red velvet ribbon, the shop windows the only light, snow falling
hook_vi: Nhận ra anh ấy chậm mất một nhịp 🔔

shots.action: Maya walks past the gift-stacked shop window in her shearling-collared coat, handbag on her wrist, big hair catching the snow.
Maya stops, closes her eyes and tips her head back, breathing in the snow, held.
Lucas in an ivory dinner jacket sips cocoa from a red paper cup, eyes on her over the rim.

line.vi: Em sắp đóng băng rồi đấy.

shots.action: Maya opens one eye at him, unbothered.
Giant gold jingle bells with a red velvet ribbon swing in the shop window.
Lucas looks back over his shoulder as he walks on, a slow smirk.
Maya gasps, both hands up to her chest, hoops swinging.
Lucas, already walking away, raises the red cup without turning round.
Maya's slow smile straight to camera, eyes bright, snow on her lashes.

twist: She brushes off a stranger and realises a beat late who he was; he knew all along.
cta_vi: Bạn có chạy theo không? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇

setting: an alpine lodge living room at Christmas, a stone fireplace, a tree in warm lights, a buffalo-plaid blanket on the sofa, snow at the dark window, the fire and tree lights the only light

phrase.explain_vi: Lời biện hộ kinh điển (như 'chó ăn mất bài tập'), ai cũng biết là bịa.
phrase.example_en: Where's my sandwich? - The dog ate it.
phrase.example_vi: Bánh mì của tôi đâu? - Chó ăn mất rồi.

shots.action: Sienna carries a tray of gingerbread men across the firelit room; a golden retriever pads after the tray, nose up.
The tray lands on the low table; a golden nose pushes in and one gingerbread man vanishes.
Theo on the sofa in his cream turtleneck freezes mid-chew, cheeks full.
Sienna, arms folded, one brow up.
Theo points at the dog; the dog yawns with crumbs on its nose.
Theo, dead straight face.

line.vi: Chó ăn mất rồi. Thật đấy.

shots.action: Theo's hand slides a gingerbread man under the plaid cushion.
Sienna crouches to the dog, sweet voice, eyes flicking up to Theo.
Theo chews slowly, eyes closed, caught, crumbs on his sweater.

twist: He blames the dog; the dog gets the praise and he gets the crumbs.
cta_vi: Bạn tin anh ấy không? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇
